target: Working Clay Machine: ClayCode language + compiler + VM + Clay environment + Linux interoperability + minimal ClayOS
compression_note: Current workspace is intentionally compact; exact measurements and counterevidence remain in the referenced receipts and Git history.

CM-01-LANGUAGE-SPEC-PARSER-IR.evidence: 40 authorized sources; 36 parsed; syntax-only call ownership partition merged in PR #598.
CM-01-LANGUAGE-SPEC-PARSER-IR.blocker: Parser corpus remains incomplete and unresolved call/member ownership semantics remain open.

CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.evidence: PR #603 merged TypeRef alias-ancestry complexity repair; exact-head self-hosted run 31910197430 passed 12/12 including depth 32768 and bounded scaling ratio.
CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.blocker: Compact alias-DAG expansion/materialization can still grow explosively; require a resource bound or structural sharing without changing nominal alias meaning.

CM-03-EVALUATOR-INTERPRETER.evidence: Existing structured parser/evaluator is now used as the semantic source for canonical executable IR rather than reparsing body_tokens.
CM-03-EVALUATOR-INTERPRETER.blocker: Executable coverage remains a deliberately small admitted subset.

CM-04-COMPILER-LOWERING-BYTECODE.evidence: PR #609 merged ClayExecutableTypedIR/v1 with exact-head 12/12; PR #614 merged deterministic canonical executable IR -> one serialized ClayVM with exact-head 12/12 IR + 9/9 VM + 16/16 integration.
CM-04-COMPILER-LOWERING-BYTECODE.blocker: Expand lowering only for semantics already admitted by the canonical checker/IR; no backend-local language or type reinvention.

CM-05-VIRTUAL-CLAY-MACHINE.evidence: PR #608 merged the single serialized ClayVM with VM-owned frames, depth-1500 call regression and explicit frame limit; PR #619 added ClayVMArtifact/v1 provenance binding; PR #623 made package ClayOS artifact-strict.
CM-05-VIRTUAL-CLAY-MACHINE.blocker: Instruction/type/object surface remains narrow; broader verifier/object/runtime semantics remain open.

CM-06-MEMORY-CONCURRENCY-RUNTIME.blocker: VM memory/object lifetime, concurrency/scheduling and failure semantics are not yet defined as a release-grade contract.

CM-07-CLAY-ENVIRONMENT-STDLIB-SDK.evidence: PR #626 merged minimal clayenv. Exact-head run 31911536923 passed 20/20 plus real CLI build/run smoke with result 42. ClayEnvManifest/v1 deterministically binds artifact/source/grammar/executable-IR identities and run launches only through strict ClayOS.
CM-07-CLAY-ENVIRONMENT-STDLIB-SDK.blocker: No canonical module/package system or meaningful stdlib/SDK yet; current environment is a minimal host-side build/run bootstrap.

CM-08-LINUX-INTEROP.evidence: Single VM contains only a narrow capability bootstrap.
CM-08-LINUX-INTEROP.blocker: Typed filesystem/process/network/device/FFI effects with receipts and fail-closed authority are not accepted.

CM-09-MINIMAL-CLAYOS.evidence: PR #623 merged provenance-strict package ClayOS; PR #627 removed package-level raw loader export and exact-head policy scan found 0 violations across 177 production Python files; PR #626 provides the first canonical Clay environment CLI build/run route through ClayOS.exec_artifact.
CM-09-MINIMAL-CLAYOS.blocker: ClayOS is still a minimal process facade: persistent services/state, scheduling, filesystem/module services and recovery remain open.

CM-10-TOOLING-OBSERVABILITY-RECOVERY.evidence: Exact-head provenance/tamper/transplant gates, strict launch gates, raw-loader import policy and manifest/artifact identity checks are merged. PR #627 quarantines raw loader use to two audited internal bridges for repository/package/release policy.
CM-10-TOOLING-OBSERVABILITY-RECOVERY.blocker: Arbitrary Python private-module introspection is not physically sandboxed; replay/recovery/long-horizon artifact lineage and stronger process isolation remain open.

CM-11-SELF-HOSTING-BOOTSTRAP.blocker: No selected compiler/runtime component is yet self-hosted in ClayCode with bootstrap-equivalence evidence.

frontier.next_discriminator: Highest-value next work: expand canonical already-admitted semantics through the same executable-IR/single-VM path and establish canonical modules/stdlib packaging in ClayEnv. Parallel bounded blocker: resource-safe alias-DAG materialization. Then define typed Linux effects and persistent/recoverable ClayOS services.

coordination_negative_result: Parallel GO workers can collide on unusual-experiment accounting and shared frontiers. CAS/lease discipline remains required. This macrocycle also exposed a CI provenance pitfall: github.sha on pull_request is the merge ref unless workflows explicitly checkout and assert github.event.pull_request.head.sha.
